name: Dr. Ali Bazrafkan
bio: Assistant Professor of Precision Agriculture at Montana State University. His lab combines UAV and satellite remote sensing, GIS modeling and machine learning to turn imagery into decisions, from high-throughput crop phenotyping to mapping irrigation across entire regions. He earned his Ph.D. at North Dakota State University, did postdoctoral work at Michigan State University, and spent a decade before that as a GIS and remote sensing specialist in applied agriculture.
